Farming Incentives.methodology: esGMX vested into GMX by GLP LPs and affiliates via vester contracts on Arbitrum and Avalanche

glp-vester.name: GLP LP Vesting
glp-vester.methodology: Tracks Claim events from GLP Vester contracts on Arbitrum and Avalanche. GLP LPs earn esGMX which vests into GMX over 1 year.

affiliate-vester.name: Affiliate Vesting
affiliate-vester.methodology: Tracks Claim events from Affiliate Vester contracts on Arbitrum and Avalanche. Referral affiliates earn esGMX which vests into GMX.
